name: TOOLS-GITHUB-ACTIONS-MONITOR-ANDROID
technologies: Read API v1 of GitHub Actions Monitor
build: Not built yet: there is no Android project. The repository checks run with python -I tools/ci_validate.py.
notes: Scaffolding v0.0.1: the planned Android app of GitHub Actions Monitor, which would show the state of the workflows and the alerts of the monitor of its own user on a phone. It only reads from the monitor and writes nothing to GitHub. There is no code yet: this repository holds only its base (documents, manifest, licence and shared checks). Nothing has been built, tested or run on a phone.
